## Change Summary

Describe the user-facing or operational impact of this change.

## Required Review Checklist

- [ ] I added the change as an unchecked item in `todo.md` before implementation and marked it complete only after validation.
- [ ] I reviewed existing feature and shared components before creating a new component or interaction primitive.
- [ ] I reused an existing component, or documented why no existing semantic fit was available.
- [ ] I used `next/link` for internal navigation and `next/image` for rendered images.
- [ ] I used existing Lucide or React Icons rather than emoji or raw symbol controls.
- [ ] I kept persistent state behind server-managed cookies and server-side storage rather than browser storage.
- [ ] I added or updated focused tests for successful and invalid or unavailable paths.
- [ ] `pnpm quality` passes locally.

## Deployment Notes

List migrations, managed environment variables, feature flags, rollback considerations, or state explicitly if none are needed.
